title: Wilderness · Old Owl Well

sourceRecords.title: Optional lead · Old Owl Well
read: The broken watchtower stands where you last saw Hamun Kost. What remains here depends on what the party left behind.

The broken stone is a landmark you can recognize without deciding what happened after your departure. You can compare the ground and the tower with your last visit, look for an actual new trace, or keep watch while someone examines the place more closely.

brief: Old Owl Well: rugged hills, ancient tower reduced to BROKEN STUMP, rubble walls enclose courtyard, still working ordinary WELL, colorful travel TENT at courtyard center. NO wizard in view because Hamun Kost disappeared; twelve zombies remain hidden inside tower, not visible from approach. No intact enormous wizard tower or visible portal.
